## Fixer Receipt

**status:** completed  
**phase:** apply  
**commit:** `a90c605a42202745ace38f7a3252fa4416007d34`  
**title:** `fix(recorder): fail closed on Git reference identity scans`  
**starting HEAD:** `5bc6c59ad795f8cb9192be3705d94e81e3a30d95`  
**forward descendant:** yes (merge-base ancestor check passed)  
**working tree:** clean after commit  

### Root cause
`verifyGitReference` scanned `repositoryRoot` and `path`, then wrote scanner-rewritten values into `ReferenceIdentity`. A credential-shaped directory coordinate (e.g. `token=...`) therefore admitted with mutated identity and could still promote.

### Fix
In `src/recorder/admit.ts::verifyGitReference`, immediately after scanning both identity fields and before constructing `AdmittedArtifact`:
- compare scanned values to the verified originals and check redaction flags
- on any identity mutation, throw `RecorderError("reference-failed", ...)`
- on success, return exact `repositoryRoot` and `ref.path` with `redactionStatus: "clean"` (never `[REDACTED]` / synthetic coordinates)

- `test/recorder-admission.test.ts` — e2e toxic-coordinate failure (exit 125, no spawn, no docket, archive Git unchanged) plus clean-coordinate control (one spawn, promotion)
